questions.title: 数据缺失条件下的感官评分：50 维 mapped grade 多输出预测
questions.objective: 以 1.csv 的化合物/理化数据为输入特征，预测 problem/targetcolumns.csv 定义的 50 个 Aroma/Flavour/口感-缺陷-总体感官维度的 mapped grade（由 4.csv 标准化值经显式映射 6*(z-zmin)/(zmax-zmin) 得到）：输出 50 维连续评分、整体与分层误差、误差分析图。
inputs: DATA-Q1mapped（data/processed/q1_mapped.csv：row/beer/beer_id/tasting_category_fine + 231 个 chem__ 特征 + 50 个 mapped grade 目标列）
SPLIT-Q1（random-holdout，testFraction=0.2，seed=20261024，按行位置 80/20，训练 200 行 / 测试 50 行）
problem/targetcolumns.csv（50 个目标列的权威映射）
outputs: 50 维 mapped grade 预测（predictions.csv + predictions_long.csv）
整体 MAE 与逐目标/分层误差表（holdout 与 train-only OOF 两套口径）
误差分析图：逐目标 MAE 条形图、预测-真值散点、残差分布
特征重要性/系数稳定性诊断
constraints: 目标列严格为 problem/targetcolumns.csv 的 50 列，不增不减，不自造列名
原始 0–6 分不可识别（3.xlsx 评分卡为空白模板、summary 结果全 0、4.csv 标准化参数未知、clove 最大值 6.17>6），只交付 mapped grade，不称原始 0–6
mapped grade 的 zmin/zmax 只能在训练行上估计，不得用测试目标拟合；越界/端点处理必须写明
输入特征只能来自 1.csv 的化合物/理化列；4.csv 的 50 个感官列与 7.csv 一律禁止作为输入
holdout 只用于最终比较，选模与调参只用 train-only 的 KFold/OOF；holdout 复用 ≤3 次
4.csv/7.csv 的 beer_id 截断（250 行仅 96 个不同值），跨表只按 beer/行位置合并
questions.evaluation: 多输出 mapped-grade MAE：holdout 上 50 个目标各自 MAE 的均匀平均（uniform-average），并由 holdout-metrics 从 predictions_long.csv 逐对复算校验

analysisPlan.decisionTime: 化合物/理化检测完成、感官评分尚未获得时（仅用 1.csv 的 231 个化学/理化检测量）

questions.title: 化合物–风味分析：每个感官维度的 Top-3 关键化合物与稳定性论证
questions.objective: 利用 2.csv 的化合物相关结构构建化合物共表达图，结合 1.csv 化学特征，给出 4.csv 每个感官维度（50 维）的 Top-3 关键因素化合物，并用 bootstrap 重采样入选频率与多方法间 Jaccard 系数量化稳定性，辅以化学合理性论证。
inputs: DATA-Q2raw（data/processed/q2_raw.csv：231 个 chem__ 特征 + 50 个原始标准化感官列）
SPLIT-Q2（random-holdout，testFraction=0.2，seed=20261024，训练 200 行 / 测试 50 行）
2.csv（231×232 化合物 Spearman 相关矩阵，仅作共表达结构参考）
outputs: 每个感官维度的 Top-3 关键化合物（至少两种方法/排序，sets.json）
bootstrap 重采样下 Top-3 入选频率表
方法间 Top-3 Jaccard 系数矩阵与分布
化合物共表达图（阈值化相关图，含非 PSD 说明与必要时的 PSD 投影）
稳定性报告与化学合理性讨论
constraints: 同期关联分析，不得表述为因果；不做未来预测
2.csv 是 Spearman 相关矩阵且非 PSD（min eig≈−0.0424），不是独立外部先验；做矩阵运算/绘图前必须先声明并处理（必要时 PSD 投影）
5.csv/6.csv/7.csv 与 1/4.csv 同源派生，不得当作独立外部验证或外部数据
6.csv 实际为 44×51（题面写 46×50），行数列数需如实记录，不按题面想当然
bootstrap 必须固定随机种子并说明重采样层级与次数
holdout 复用 ≤3 次；Top-3 的选择只在训练行内进行
questions.evaluation: 方法间 Top-3 集合的 Jaccard 系数（逐维 Jaccard 的均值，topK=3），并报告 bootstrap 入选频率作为第二稳定性证据

analysisPlan.decisionTime: 分析时使用 1.csv 与 4.csv 的汇总（同期）；不声称因果、不做未来预测
excludedFeatures: 7.csv 的全部 aroma_* 感官描述列（与 4.csv 同源派生，不作输入也不作外部验证）
5.csv 的 50×50 感官相关阵与 6.csv 的 44×51 交叉相关阵（派生量，不作独立外部先验）
2.csv 的化合物相关阵（Spearman、非 PSD，仅作共表达结构参考）

questions.title: 风味与风味指纹生成：风格条件生成、感官画像与跨风格迁移
questions.objective: 以 tasting_category_fine 为风格标签学习风格条件生成模型，在给定风格（Tripel、Kriek、Lambic 等）下生成合理的化合物谱并给出感官画像；再做跨风格迁移（把 Pils/Lager 的化合物谱迁移为 Tripel 风格），并以 DMS/Diacetyl/4VG/trans-2-nonenal/Stale hops 等超阈值项为缺陷约束，检查缺陷化合物不恶化。
inputs: DATA-Q3（data/processed/q3_table.csv：style + style_holdout + 231 个 chem__ 化合物列 + 8.xlsx 解析出的 thr__* 缺陷阈值常量列）
style_holdout 列（held-out 风格 = Tripel/Kriek/Lambic，显式跨风格切分）
8.xlsx「Sensory thresholds」（261 行中仅 43 行有阈值、7 个异味标记）
outputs: 各风格的条件化合物谱（generated_profiles.csv）与感官画像
跨风格迁移结果与缺陷项逐项前后对比（transfer_report.csv）
约束满足率、能量距离、画像一致性、缺陷不恶化率
风格感官画像雷达/条形图、生成谱与真实谱分布对比图、迁移前后缺陷项对比图
constraints: 生成合理性/约束满足/分布一致性评价，不是真实酿造验证；不得表述为因果或未来预测
缺陷化合物判定以 8.xlsx 真实解析出的阈值为准，解析不到的必须列出并说明，不得编造阈值
style 是条件标签而非普通预测目标，不得把 style 或生成结果伪装成预测标签
跨风格迁移必须显式使用 style_holdout 列构造风格留出，不得用随机 split 冒充
8.xlsx 的 GBM importance MDI / GBM SHAP Values 是同批 250 样本的拟合产物，禁止作为输入特征；Prices 不作核心输入
holdout 复用 ≤3 次；无条件基线必须先跑
questions.evaluation: 约束满足率（constraint-satisfaction）：生成谱满足缺陷阈值与风格画像约束的比例，辅以能量距离、画像一致性与缺陷不恶化率

analysisPlan.decisionTime: 生成时已知目标风格（condition）与 8.xlsx 缺陷阈值；不声称真实酿造验证
excludedFeatures: tasting_category_fine / style（生成条件标签，不是普通输入特征）
style_holdout（仅用于显式跨风格切分）
8.xlsx 的 GBM importance MDI 与 GBM SHAP Values（同批 250 样本拟合产物，禁止作输入特征）
8.xlsx 的 Beer Prices（大量 NA，不作核心输入）
thr__* 常量列（缺陷阈值，作为约束边界而非输入特征）

datasets.notes: DATA-Q1mapped. 250x285 = row,beer,beer_id,tasting_category_fine + 231 chem__<1.csv columns> + 50 mapped-grade targets (problem/targetcolumns.csv order). Lineage: 1.csv (RAW-41984922) features + 4.csv (RAW-43a7b386) targets joined by ROW POSITION only (beer/tasting_category_fine verified identical; 4.csv beer_id truncated to 96 distinct values so it is not a join key); problem/targetcolumns.csv proves 50/50. Targets = mapped grade x=6*(z-zmin)/(zmax-zmin), zmin/zmax fitted on the 200 TRAIN rows of seed 20261024 only; original 0-6 is NOT recoverable. 15 cells fall outside [0,6] (7 below, 8 above) and are left un-clipped. 73 missing cells in 9 chemical columns imputed with the train-row median. Produced by SCRIPT-0001 (exit 0). QA: data/processed/data_quality.json.

fields.name: row
fields.description: 0-based row position in 4.csv (and in 1.csv, which is row-aligned); this is the row id the holdout split assigns (assignment.csv row_index).

fields.name: beer
fields.description: 1.csv/4.csv beer column: a permutation of 1..250 (identical in both files), so row != beer. Legal join key; reported next to row for traceability.

fields.name: beer_id

datasets.notes: DATA-Q2raw. 250x285, same layout as DATA-0001 but the 50 target columns keep the 4.csv standardized/centred values unchanged (no mapped-grade transform). For Q2 compound-flavour association only. Lineage: 1.csv (RAW-41984922) + 4.csv (RAW-43a7b386) by ROW POSITION; problem/targetcolumns.csv 50/50. 73 missing chem cells imputed with the train-row median (same rule as DATA-0001). Targets are NOT original 0-6 ratings; 2/5/6/7 are derived Spearman matrices of the same 250 samples and are NOT independent external data. Produced by SCRIPT-0001 (exit 0). QA: data/processed/data_quality.json.

datasets.notes: DATA-Q3. 250x279 = row,beer,beer_id,style,style_holdout + 231 chem__<1.csv columns> + 43 thr__<compound> constant threshold columns. style = tasting_category_fine (22 styles) is a CONDITION, not a predicted label; style_holdout = heldout_style for Tripel(28)/Kriek(10)/Lambic(11) = 49 rows and train_style for the other 201. Thresholds parsed from 8.xlsx "Sensory thresholds" (RAW-f2316766): 261 rows -> 43 numeric thresholds (field_name_R exact join to 1.csv names, 43/43) and 7 off_flavors flags; nothing invented. Defect compounds named by the problem: DMS 17.25 ug/L, Diacetyl(X2.3.butanedione) 0.29925 mg/L, 4VG(X4VG) 0.206333 mg/L have real thresholds; trans-2-nonenal (X.E..2.nonenal) and "stale hops" have NO numeric threshold in the attachment -> recorded as not evaluable (see q3_thresholds.json notParsed). Forbidden inputs excluded: 8.xlsx GBM importance MDI and GBM SHAP Values are model outputs of these same 250 samples; Beer Prices is mostly NA; Calibrated chemical dataset used only as a scale reference. Produced by SCRIPT-0002 (exit 0). QA: data/processed/q3_thresholds.json + data_quality.json.

datasets.notes: DATA-0004 = unexposed evaluation pool for Q1 robustness. ROW SUBSET ONLY: 200 of the 250 rows of DATA-0001 (q1_mapped.csv), namely the rows that are NOT in SPLIT-0001's 50-row test set; original parent order kept; the `row` ids are NOT renumbered (0..249 with the 50 main-test ids missing) so every pool row is traceable to the same beer in DATA-0001. Columns identical to DATA-0001 (285); all values carried over unchanged, INCLUDING the 50 mapped-grade targets (checked max|diff| = 0 versus the parent rows at the same `row` ids: no zmin/zmax is re-estimated for the pool, per the rule that a robustness pool must not redefine labels). Honest consequence, recorded in pools_quality.json: these 200 rows ARE the rows that fitted the main affine map, so each pool row participated in the rescaling (weak leakage through 2 scalars per target, not per-sample information). Purpose: let Q1 robustness experiments (new pre-registered seeds) put their TEST rows on samples never used as a main holdout, instead of re-using SPLIT-0001. Produced by SCRIPT-0006 (exit 0). Checks: data/processed/pools_quality.json.

datasets.notes: DATA-0005 = unexposed evaluation pool for Q2 robustness. ROW SUBSET ONLY: the 200 rows of DATA-0002 (q2_raw.csv) that are NOT in SPLIT-0002's 50-row test set; parent order kept; `row` ids NOT renumbered; columns identical (285); all values unchanged (max|diff| = 0 for every numeric column against the parent rows, targets included -> the 4.csv standardized values are carried over, not recomputed). No mapped grade here, so no affine-rescaling caveat applies to this pool. Purpose: Q2 robustness experiments (new pre-registered seeds) can put their TEST rows on samples never used as a main holdout. Produced by SCRIPT-0006 (exit 0). Checks: data/processed/pools_quality.json.

fields.name: row
fields.description: ORIGINAL 0-based row position in 1.csv/4.csv — NOT renumbered: this pool is a row subset of DATA-0003 kept in parent file order, so `row` is still the id of the same beer sample in the parent dataset. The gaps are the rows used as the main split SPLIT-0003 test set (50 of 250); 200 rows are kept.

datasets.notes: DATA-0006 = unexposed evaluation pool for Q3 robustness. ROW SUBSET ONLY: the 200 rows of DATA-0003 (q3_table.csv) that are NOT in SPLIT-0003's 50-row test set; parent order kept; `row` ids NOT renumbered; columns identical (279); all values unchanged (max|diff| = 0, thresholds included: 43 thr__ columns remain constant). style_holdout composition after subsetting: 160 train_style + 40 heldout_style, with the held-out styles Tripel 23 / Kriek 8 / Lambic 9 (all three survive the subset, so Q3 robustness can still fit on style_holdout). Purpose: Q3 robustness experiments (new pre-registered seeds) can put their TEST rows on samples never used as a main holdout. Produced by SCRIPT-0006 (exit 0). Checks: data/processed/pools_quality.json.

models.title: Q1 baseline: constant per target (train median), 50 mapped-grade outputs
assumptions: The 50 targets are mapped grades, not the original 0-6 scale (mapping uses TRAIN-only zmin/zmax).
A constant predictor per target is the naive comparator: it uses no chemical feature.
Holdout rows are scored exactly once by this baseline.
equations: yhat_t = median_{i in TRAIN}(y_{i,t}) for each of the 50 targets t
mae = (1/50) * sum_t MAE_holdout(t)
models.algorithm: Per-target train median; train-only 5-fold OOF of the same rule reported as a secondary number; holdout MAE averaged uniformly over the 50 mapped targets.

params.algorithmDetail: constant per target = TRAIN median of that target

models.title: Q1 candidate 1: multi-output ridge on 231 chem/physical features (alpha by train-only CV)
assumptions: The 50 targets are mapped grades, not original 0-6 scores.
Chemical/physical features are available at tasting time (contemporaneous association task).
Holdout rows are used once, for the reported number only; alpha is chosen on train-only CV.
equations: y_t = X beta_t + eps_t, minimise ||y_t - X beta_t||^2 + alpha ||beta_t||^2 for each target t
alpha* = argmin_alpha mean_{5-fold} |y - yhat| on TRAIN rows only
mae = (1/50) sum_t MAE_holdout(t)
models.algorithm: Multi-output ridge (L2) on median-imputed, train-standardised chem__* features; alpha from TRAIN-only 5-fold CV over a fixed grid; one prediction pass over the holdout.

models.title: Q1 candidate 2: per-target histogram gradient boosting (non-linear family)
assumptions: The 50 targets are mapped grades, not original 0-6 scores.
Non-linear interactions between compounds matter; trees can capture them without hand-crafted transforms.
Holdout rows are used once, for the reported number only.
equations: for each target t: y_t = sum_m g_m(x) with gradient-boosted trees fitted by least squares
mae = (1/50) sum_t MAE_holdout(t)
models.algorithm: One HistGradientBoostingRegressor per target (fixed a-priori hyper-parameters, no holdout tuning); train-only 5-fold OOF reported as secondary; holdout scored once.

models.title: Q2 baseline: global (dimension-independent) Top-3, two pooled selectors
assumptions: Q2 asks for a Top-3 per sensory dimension; a single global list is the naive comparator.
Only TRAIN rows of the registered split are used for ranking; the holdout rows play no role in this descriptive analysis.
Associations are contemporaneous, not causal; 2.csv is a derived Spearman matrix, not an independent prior.
equations: global score_j = mean_d |Spearman(chem_j, sensory_d)| ; Top-3 by score
topk-jaccard = mean_d mean_{(a,b)} |A_da cap A_db| / |A_da cup A_db|
models.algorithm: Two GLOBAL (dimension-independent) Top-3 selectors: pooled mean |Spearman rho| and pooled mean |ridge coefficient| over the 50 dimensions; the same 3 compounds are used for every dimension.

params.scope: descriptive contemporaneous association on TRAIN rows only; not causal, not external validation

models.title: Q2 candidate: per-dimension Top-3 (Spearman/ridge/random-forest) with bootstrap stability and 2.csv co-expression
assumptions: The 50 sensory dimensions are the association targets of a descriptive analysis, not prediction targets.
Only TRAIN rows of SPLIT-0002 are used for every ranking, the ridge alpha and the bootstrap resampling.
2.csv is a derived Spearman matrix and is not PSD; it is a co-expression reference, not an independent external prior, and 5/6/7.csv are not used as validation.
Associations are contemporaneous; no causal claim is made.
equations: score_j^spearman = |rho_S(chem_j, sensory_d)| ; score_j^ridge = |beta_j| from ridge on standardised X ; score_j^rf = impurity importance
Top-3_d^method = argmax_3 score^{method}(., d)
topk-jaccard = mean_d mean_{a<b} |A_da cap A_db| / |A_da cup A_db|
models.algorithm: Per sensory dimension, three rankings (|Spearman rho|, |ridge coefficient| with train-only CV alpha, random-forest impurity importance); Top-3 per method; stability = mean pairwise Top-3 Jaccard per dimension (then over the 50 dimensions) plus bootstrap Top-3 inclusion frequencies from 500 train-row resamples. 2.csv (declared Spearman matrix, non-PSD) is projected by eigenvalue clipping and used only as co-expression structure.

params.scope: descriptive contemporaneous association on TRAIN rows only; not causal, not external validation

models.title: Q3 baseline: unconditional global generator (independent per compound)
assumptions: The style label carries information the baseline ignores, so this is the naive comparator.
Fitting uses ONLY style_holdout == train_style rows (201); the 49 held-out-style rows are used only to compare distributions.
trans-2-nonenal and 'Stale hops' have no numeric threshold in 8.xlsx and are reported as not assessable, never given an invented threshold.
This is generation reasonableness / constraint satisfaction, NOT a real brewing validation.
equations: x_j ~ Normal(mean_j, sd_j) independently for each compound j (TRAIN rows only)
excess_j = inverse_transform(chem_j) / thr_j - 1
constraint-satisfaction = #{rows : all 7 excess_j <= 0} / #rows
models.algorithm: Unconditional global Gaussian: each compound sampled independently from its TRAIN distribution (mean, sd per compound); 300 generated profiles; the seven thresholded defect compounds are scored with excess = inverse_transform(chem)/thr - 1.

params.scope: generation reasonableness / constraint satisfaction; NOT a real brewing validation

models.title: Q3 candidate: style-conditional Gaussian with defect-constraint projection, cross-style transfer and sensory-profile proxy
assumptions: Held-out styles are not observed at fit time; conditioning uses an a-priori beer-style family mapping registered before the run (domain knowledge, not held-out data).
Only style_holdout == train_style rows (201) are fitted; the 49 held-out-style rows are used only for distributional comparison.
Constraint satisfaction is a design target: the generator projects the seven thresholded defect compounds onto their threshold; the unconstrained rate is reported for comparison.
trans-2-nonenal and 'Stale hops' have no numeric threshold in 8.xlsx: reported as not assessable, never assigned an invented threshold.
The sensory profile is a Ridge surrogate fitted on Q1 training rows, not measured ratings and not the Q1 final model.
Generation reasonableness / constraint satisfaction / distributional consistency, NOT a real brewing validation and no causal claim.
equations: z ~ Normal(mu_style, C), C = (1-lambda) Cov + lambda diag(Cov), lambda = 0.5
mu_style = mean of standardised TRAIN compounds over the pre-registered style pool
x = z * sd + mean (data scale)
constrained: chem_j <- threshold_j in the column's own scale when excess_j > 0 (margin 1e-9)
excess_j = inverse_transform(chem_j)/thr_j - 1 ; constraint-satisfaction = fraction of rows with all 7 excess <= 0
models.algorithm: Per held-out style: a pre-registered a-priori style-family mapping picks a training-style pool; a style prototype mean plus a shared covariance shrunk toward its diagonal (lambda = 0.5, n=201 < p=231) defines the conditional Gaussian; 100 spectra per style are drawn. The seven thresholded defect compounds are then clipped to their threshold (only when exceeded) => constrained generator. Cross-style transfer: real Pils/Lager spectra shifted by (mu_Tripel - mu_PilsLager) with defect compounds unshifted. Sensory profile from a Ridge proxy fitted on the registered Q1 training rows (surrogate, not measured).

transfer.rule: x' = x + (mu_target - mu_source); defect compounds unshifted in the constrained variant

params.scope: generation reasonableness / constraint satisfaction / distributional consistency; NOT a real brewing validation; no causal claim

experiments.title: Q3 candidate: style-conditional Gaussian with defect-constraint projection, cross-style transfer and sensory-profile proxy
assumptions: Held-out styles are not observed at fit time; conditioning uses an a-priori beer-style family mapping registered before the run (domain knowledge, not held-out data).
Only style_holdout == train_style rows (201) are fitted; the 49 held-out-style rows are used only for distributional comparison.
Constraint satisfaction is a design target: the generator projects the seven thresholded defect compounds onto their threshold; the unconstrained rate is reported for comparison.
trans-2-nonenal and 'Stale hops' have no numeric threshold in 8.xlsx: reported as not assessable, never assigned an invented threshold.
The sensory profile is a Ridge surrogate fitted on Q1 training rows, not measured ratings and not the Q1 final model.
Generation reasonableness / constraint satisfaction / distributional consistency, NOT a real brewing validation and no causal claim.
equations: z ~ Normal(mu_style, C), C = (1-lambda) Cov + lambda diag(Cov), lambda = 0.5
mu_style = mean of standardised TRAIN compounds over the pre-registered style pool
x = z * sd + mean (data scale)
constrained: chem_j <- threshold_j in the column's own scale when excess_j > 0 (margin 1e-9)
excess_j = inverse_transform(chem_j)/thr_j - 1 ; constraint-satisfaction = fraction of rows with all 7 excess <= 0
experiments.algorithm: Per held-out style: a pre-registered a-priori style-family mapping picks a training-style pool; a style prototype mean plus a shared covariance shrunk toward its diagonal (lambda = 0.5, n=201 < p=231) defines the conditional Gaussian; 100 spectra per style are drawn. The seven thresholded defect compounds are then clipped to their threshold (only when exceeded) => constrained generator. Cross-style transfer: real Pils/Lager spectra shifted by (mu_Tripel - mu_PilsLager) with defect compounds unshifted. Sensory profile from a Ridge proxy fitted on the registered Q1 training rows (surrogate, not measured).

transfer.rule: x' = x + (mu_target - mu_source); defect compounds unshifted in the constrained variant

experiments.title: independent rerun 1/1 of EXP-0007
assumptions: Held-out styles are not observed at fit time; conditioning uses an a-priori beer-style family mapping registered before the run (domain knowledge, not held-out data).
Only style_holdout == train_style rows (201) are fitted; the 49 held-out-style rows are used only for distributional comparison.
Constraint satisfaction is a design target: the generator projects the seven thresholded defect compounds onto their threshold; the unconstrained rate is reported for comparison.
trans-2-nonenal and 'Stale hops' have no numeric threshold in 8.xlsx: reported as not assessable, never assigned an invented threshold.
The sensory profile is a Ridge surrogate fitted on Q1 training rows, not measured ratings and not the Q1 final model.
Generation reasonableness / constraint satisfaction / distributional consistency, NOT a real brewing validation and no causal claim.
equations: z ~ Normal(mu_style, C), C = (1-lambda) Cov + lambda diag(Cov), lambda = 0.5
mu_style = mean of standardised TRAIN compounds over the pre-registered style pool
x = z * sd + mean (data scale)
constrained: chem_j <- threshold_j in the column's own scale when excess_j > 0 (margin 1e-9)
excess_j = inverse_transform(chem_j)/thr_j - 1 ; constraint-satisfaction = fraction of rows with all 7 excess <= 0
experiments.algorithm: Per held-out style: a pre-registered a-priori style-family mapping picks a training-style pool; a style prototype mean plus a shared covariance shrunk toward its diagonal (lambda = 0.5, n=201 < p=231) defines the conditional Gaussian; 100 spectra per style are drawn. The seven thresholded defect compounds are then clipped to their threshold (only when exceeded) => constrained generator. Cross-style transfer: real Pils/Lager spectra shifted by (mu_Tripel - mu_PilsLager) with defect compounds unshifted. Sensory profile from a Ridge proxy fitted on the registered Q1 training rows (surrogate, not measured).

transfer.rule: x' = x + (mu_target - mu_source); defect compounds unshifted in the constrained variant

registration.algorithm: Per held-out style: a pre-registered a-priori style-family mapping picks a training-style pool; a style prototype mean plus a shared covariance shrunk toward its diagonal (lambda = 0.5, n=201 < p=231) defines the conditional Gaussian; 100 spectra per style are drawn. The seven thresholded defect compounds are then clipped to their threshold (only when exceeded) => constrained generator. Cross-style transfer: real Pils/Lager spectra shifted by (mu_Tripel - mu_PilsLager) with defect compounds unshifted. Sensory profile from a Ridge proxy fitted on the registered Q1 training rows (surrogate, not measured).

transfer.rule: x' = x + (mu_target - mu_source); defect compounds unshifted in the constrained variant

validationPlans.protocolNote: Q1（50 维 mapped grade 多输出，primary metric mae，direction minimize）的评价协议，在任何候选实验之前登记。holdout 预算：maxHoldoutReuse=3，分配为 baseline 1 次 + 候选 ≤2 次，只用于最终比较；选模与超参一律用 train-only KFold/OOF，holdout 上的数字不回流到模型选择。泄漏口径：Q1 的输入只能是 1.csv 的 231 个化学/理化量，4.csv 的 50 个感官列与 7.csv 一律禁止。mapped grade 的 zmin/zmax 只由 200 个训练行估计（训练行映射后严格落在 [0,6]，测试行有 15 个格子越界 −0.468~9.750，不裁剪、如实报告），因此「原始 0–6」不可交付，只交付 mapped grade。baseline-compare 因需要 baseline 实验 id，按「先跑 baseline、再跑候选、协议先于比较」的顺序在第二个计划里登记。independent-rerun 只对最终选中的模型做一次，属复现性验证、不参与选择。

Q2（化合物–风味分析，primary metric topk-jaccard）协议，在任何候选方法之前登记。注意该指标是「方法间 Top-3 集合一致性」，不是模型优劣；因此不登记 baseline-compare（把「与基线不同」当成「更好」是口径错误），Q2 的基线（全局统一 Top-3）与逐维方法的比较以「Jaccard 有多大、bootstrap 入选频率多稳定」如实报告，不做方向性宣称。holdout 预算：≤3，仅在训练行内做 Top-3 选择与 bootstrap 重采样，测试行只用于最终确认同一套排序在留出行上的相关方向是否一致。同源边界：2.csv 只是 231×232 的 Spearman 化合物相关阵且非 PSD（min eig≈−0.0424），只作共表达结构参考，必要时做 PSD 投影并记录；5.csv(50×50)/6.csv(实际 44×51)/7.csv(250×189) 与 1/4.csv 同源派生，不作独立外部验证。禁止因果与未来预测表述。

Q3（风格条件生成 + 感官画像 + 跨风格迁移，primary metric constraint-satisfaction，direction maximize）协议，在任何候选生成方法之前登记。指标定义必须在实验脚本里显式写出：生成谱满足「缺陷阈值不超 + 风格画像在容许带宽内」的样本比例；辅助指标 energy-distance / profile-consistency / defect-nonworsen-rate 只作论文表格，不进 claim refs。缺陷阈值只对 8.xlsx 里真实存在的 7 个数值阈值列生效：DMS、X2.3.butanedione(Diacetyl)、X4VG(4VG)、acetaldehyde、DES、H2S、SO2；trans-2-nonenal 与 Stale hops 在附件里没有数值阈值，如实写为「不可评估」的 limitation，绝不编阈值；其余 36 个阈值列（bitterness 5 IBU、ethanol 1.76 等「普通水平」）不得当缺陷判定。浓度换算必须按 data_quality.json 的 scaleAudit 逐列决定是否取 10 的幂（196 列 log10 / CS2 与 X4VG 零值底限 / 33 列原始浓度）。跨风格迁移必须按 style_holdout 列显式留出风格，不得用随机 split 冒充。结论只能表述为生成合理性与约束满足，不是真实酿造验证，不得做因果或未来预测表述。holdout 预算 ≤3。

【更正声明 — 必须记录】VP-0001 里我把 holdout-metrics 声明为 required:false，理由写的是"本 pack 只能把单个预测列对一个真值列复算、50 输出无法复算"。该结论是**基于过期源码得出的错误结论**：我当时读的是工作区副本 packs/modeling-contest（旧版 validate.py），而实际运行的是已安装插件 ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-vibe-math/...，其 runtime/quality/evaluation.js 原生支持 kind='multi-output'：从实验的 predictions.csv 逐目标用 y_pred__<target> 复算，真值取已登记 split 的 test.csv，按 50 目标均匀平均，并与 metrics['mae'] 比对（容差取 evaluation.tolerance，默认 1e-8）。因此本计划 VP-0004 把 holdout-metrics 作为 **required:true** 重新登记，口径是真正的证据复算，不是信息性尝试。VP-0001 中那条 required:false 的同名检查已被本计划取代。

Q2 的原生证据复算（补充 VP-0002）。指标定义固定为：对每个感官维度 d，对方法两两组合 (a,b) 算 Jaccard(a,b)=|A∩B|/(|A|+|B|−|A∩B|)（topK=3），perTarget[d]=该维度所有方法对的均值，最终 value=50 个维度 perTarget 的均值。脚本的 metrics['topk-jaccard'] 必须用完全相同的定义（这是描述性一致性，不是独立验证，也不是因果证据）。sets.json 必须是 JSON 数组且行数恰为 50×方法数，每行 items 恰 3 个且互不重复；嵌套结构另存 sets_nested.json 供论文/图用，不参与复算。若方法数=2，则每维只有 1 个方法对，value 即 50 维 Jaccard 均值。

Q3 的原生证据复算（补充 VP-0003）。约束边界来自 MCON-0001 的结构化 constraints（7 个 excess__<化合物> 列，全部 max:0），不是自由文本；generated_profiles.csv 必须真含这 7 列，并按 data_quality.json 的 scaleAudit 逐列反变换（196 列 log10 取 10 的幂；CS2/X4VG 零值底限列在存储值等于 floor code 时原始浓度按 0；33 列原始浓度直接取值）。约束满足率 = 某行 7 个 excess 全部 ≤0 才算该行满足；metrics['constraint-satisfaction'] 必须等于该比例。trans-2-nonenal 与 Stale hops 无附件阈值，不进入约束、在论文写成 limitation。该指标只证明"生成谱满足声明的数值约束"，语义合理性仍需独立审查，不构成真实酿造验证。

Q1 的 baseline-compare 协议（补充 VP-0001/VP-0004）。baseline 是 constant-train-median 逐目标常数预测，已真实跑完（EXP-0001, succeeded, mae=0.7509114931486188, train-only 5-fold OOF mae=0.7341036524616643）。该检查需要真实 baseline 实验 id，因此只能在 baseline 成功后登记；但它登记在**第一个候选之前**，所以比较口径仍然先于比较结果。选模纪律：两个候选谁入选由 train-only OOF 决定，holdout mae 只作最终比较与确认；若 OOF 最优与 holdout 最优不一致，按 OOF 选并在报告中披露差异。holdout 在同一 SPLIT-0001 上用满 3 次（baseline + 2 候选），不再增加。

Q1 final plan v2: all checks required, holdout included; fresh independent rerun
Q2 final plan: all checks required, holdout + fresh independent rerun

claims.statement: 在 DATA-0001（250 款啤酒 × 50 个感官维度的 mapped grade）上，按预注册的 seed=20261024 80/20 划分、仅使用 231 个化学/理化特征，多输出岭回归（正则系数由训练行 5 折 CV 选出）在 50 个留出样本上的 50 目标均匀平均 MAE 为 {{metric:EXP-0002:mae}}，低于逐目标常数基线的 {{metric:EXP-0001:mae}}；选模按 train-only OOF（{{metric:EXP-0002:train_only_oof_mae_mean}} vs {{metric:EXP-0001:train_only_oof_mae_mean}}），未使用 holdout 选择模型。
claims.scope: 仅该 50 行留出集内成立

quality.appliesTo: 同批 250 款商用啤酒中按 seed=20261024 划分出的 50 个留出样本；不适用于外部新样品，也不适用于原始 0–6 评分标度
limitations: 标签是 mapped grade（6*(z-zmin)/(zmax-zmin)，zmin/zmax 只用 200 个训练行估计），不是原始 0–6 评分，不能反推原始评分
训练与测试同源同批，没有任何外部啤酒验证；超出本批 250 款的样品不适用

holdout 只有 50 行：0.01 量级的差异不足以稳定区分候选；HGB 的 holdout MAE 低于所选岭回归，本题按预注册的 train-only OOF 规则选择，并如实披露该不一致
输入特征只来自 1.csv 的化学/理化量（检测时可获得）；4.csv 的 50 个感官列与 7.csv 均未进入输入

claims.statement: 对 4.csv 的 50 个感官维度，三种相互独立的逐维排序方法（训练行上的 |Spearman|、岭回归系数、随机森林不纯度重要性）给出的 Top-3 关键化合物集合，方法两两平均 Jaccard 为 {{metric:EXP-0005:topk-jaccard}}；bootstrap 重采样（训练行内 500 次）下 Top-3 的平均入选频率为 {{metric:EXP-0005:bootstrap_mean_top3_inclusion}}。这是集合一致性与重采样稳定性的描述，不构成因果证据，也不与基线作优劣比较。

quality.appliesTo: DATA-0002 的 250 款啤酒与 4.csv 的 50 个感官维度；仅描述同期相关结构，不适用于新样品或干预决策
limitations: 同期关联，不是因果：不能解释为这些化合物导致相应风味，也不能据此制定工艺干预
2.csv 是 Spearman 相关阵且非 PSD（min eig≈−0.0424），只作化合物共表达结构参考并做了 PSD 投影；不是独立外部先验
5.csv / 6.csv / 7.csv 与 1/4.csv 同源派生（重算 Spearman max|Δ|≈6.7e-16、与 Pearson 约 16.9% 符号相反），不能当作外部验证
基线的 topk-jaccard 是 2 个方法之间的 1 个方法对，候选的是 3 个方法之间的 3 个方法对的均值，两者不是同一统计量，禁止据此宣称优劣

claims.statement: 在 DATA-0003 上，风格条件高斯生成器（仅用 style_holdout=train_style 的 201 行拟合）为 Tripel/Kriek/Lambic 生成化合物谱后，经 7 项缺陷阈值投影，7 项缺陷约束同时满足的行占比为 {{metric:EXP-0007:constraint-satisfaction}}。该数值是缺陷阈值投影这一后处理直接构造的结果，不是独立质量证据：同一生成器未投影时仅 {{metric:EXP-0007:constraint-satisfaction-unconstrained}}，250 个真实样本的同一基率为 {{metric:EXP-0007:real_sample_constraint_satisfaction}}（held-out 风格样本中为 {{metric:EXP-0007:heldout-real-base-rate}}）。可交付的支撑是：投影几乎不改变分布距离（同实验内 energy-distance {{metric:EXP-0007:energy-distance-unconstrained}}→{{metric:EXP-0007:energy-distance}}）与感官画像一致性（profile-consistency {{metric:EXP-0007:profile-consistency}}，按 Q1 训练行拟合的代理模型近似、非实测评分）；Pils/Lager→Tripel 的跨风格迁移在 7 个缺陷化合物逐格上不恶化（不恶化率 {{metric:EXP-0007:defect-nonworsen-rate}}），但源谱自身满足 7 条约束的比例为 0、迁移后仍为 0，即"不恶化 ≠ 达标"。
claims.scope: Tripel / Kriek / Lambic 三个 held-out 风格的条件生成，以及 Pils/Lager→Tripel 的跨风格迁移

quality.appliesTo: DATA-0003 的 250 款啤酒与 231 维化合物域；生成谱是模型产物，不是酿造试验结果，不适用于工艺放大或感官预测
limitations: constraint-satisfaction 达到 1.0 来自对 7 个缺陷化合物做阈值投影（clipping）这一后处理，度量的是投影是否执行正确，不是生成器规避缺陷的能力；同一生成器未投影时仅约 0.04，与真实样本基率同量级

OAV/浓度换算的单位一致性是假设：1.csv 不含单位，按 8.xlsx 阈值表的单位假定，已逐列记录在 q3_thresholds.json
跨实验的 energy-distance 不可直接比较（无条件全局池 vs 3 个 held-out 风格的条件生成），不作优劣或因果结论
生成合理性/约束满足 ≠ 真实酿造验证；不得表述为因果或未来预测

figures.caption: 问题一：选中模型（多输出岭回归，alpha 由训练行内 5 折 CV 选）在 50 个 mapped grade 目标上的留出 MAE，按误差排序；纵轴为 mapped grade 单位（非原始 0–6），标题给出 50 目标均匀平均。
问题一：选中模型（岭回归）的预测值与真值散点（50 个目标 × 50 个留出行），黑线为 y = x；两轴均为 mapped grade 单位。
问题一：选中模型（岭回归）的残差分布（50 个目标池化），残差 = 预测 − 真值，单位 mapped grade；用于检查误差是否对称、是否被少数越界测试单元格拉偏。
问题一：常数基线（逐目标训练中位数，不使用任何化合物特征）的逐目标留出 MAE，与选中模型同数据、同划分、同指标口径对照；纵轴为 mapped grade 单位。
问题二：每个感官维度 × 被选关键化合物的关联强度热图；颜色为 |Spearman ρ|（训练行），空白表示三种排序方法都未把该化合物选入该维度的 Top-3。
问题二：500 次训练行内 bootstrap 重采样下 Top-3 入选频率（spearman-abs 与 ridge-coef 两种估计器平均）；频率越接近 1 表示该名次越不依赖样本偶然性。
问题二：三种排序方法两两的逐维 Top-3 Jaccard 矩阵（每个格子是 50 个维度的平均 Jaccard）；用于判断不同方法是否指向同一批关键化合物。
问题二：2.csv 共表达结构。左：2.csv 块在 PSD 投影前后的特征值谱（红=附件原样，蓝=投影后），标题给出全矩阵与块的最小特征值；右：PSD 投影后的相关块热图，仅含进入任一 Top-3 集合的化合物。2.csv 只作结构参考，不是独立外部先验。
问题三：各风格感官画像（风格条件生成 vs 训练行真实分布）。画像由 Q1 训练行拟合的代理模型近似，不是实测评分，只用于相对比较。
问题三：生成谱与真实留出谱的逐化合物均值对比（标准化空间），标题给出画像 Spearman；用于判断生成是否只学到中心、没学到离散度。
问题三：跨风格迁移（Pils/Lager → Tripel）前后 7 项缺陷化合物的超阈比例逐项对比（蓝=Pils/Lager 迁移前，红=全化合物平移，绿=缺陷化合物不平移）；迁移前后均未整体达标这一负结果如实呈现。
问题三：约束满足率对照。四根柱依次为风格条件生成（未投影）、风格条件生成（约束投影）、250 个真实样本、49 个留出风格真实样本；约束满足是用后处理投影达成的，不构成独立质量证据，因此必须同时报告未投影版本与真实基率。
